text.en:
AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE
NAME OF BORJA.
Upon the recommendation of the Secretary of the In-
terior and pursuant to the provisions of section 68 of the
Revised Administrative Code, the barrios of Sagbayan,
Canmaya Centro, Canmaya Diot, Canmano, San Antonio.
and San Isidro, and the sitios of Santa Cruz, San Vicente
Norte, San Vicente Sur, San Ramon, and Kalangahan, of
the municipality of Clarin, the sitios of Mantalongon and
Katipunan of the municipality of Inabanga, and the sitios
of Cabasacan and Ubuhan of the municipality of Balilihan,
all of the Province of Bohol, are hereby organized into an
independent municipality under the name of Borja, with
the seat of government at the barrio of Sagbayan.
The municipality herein organized shall have the fol
lowing boundaries:
From point 1, which is at the top of Cambangi Hill, sone-
where west of the sitio of Santa Cruz. as shown in the sketel
map, showing the proposed municipality and the municipal-
ities of Clarin, Inabanga, and Balilihan, submitted by the Dis-
triet Engineer, running in a straight line, N. 32° 09 E., 1.2
Km. to point No. 2, which is the center of 3-1 OM. concrete
culvert; thence N. 32° 45' E., 3.2 Km. to point 3, which is the
highest point of Carsaga Cliff; thence N. 66° 00' E., 1.6 Km., to
point 4 (Tubod sa Bungbong); thence N. 53° 20° E., to point
16 (Lampac Hill); thence southeastward to point 45 (a) some-
where southwest of the poblacion of the barrio of Cambito-or
of the municipality of Inabanga and somewhere northeast of
the sitio of Mantalongon; thence northeastward to point 20.
which is the junction of Cansuaub, Cagamo-anan and Boho
brooks; thence curving southeastward, southward and southwest-
ward along the Inabanga-Carmen boundary to the top of Kan-
liogan Hill; thence in a straight line, to Km. post 78 on the
Bacane provincial road. somewhere south of the barrio of
Canmano; thence following the provincial road to Km. post
79; thence southerly in a straight line to point 13 on the top of
Kantomacang Daku Hill; thence westward to point 49; thence
northwestward in a straight line to point 34, which is the north-
east corner of the Municipal Cemetery of Causwagan; thence I.
35° 32 W., to point 15, which is the junction of Tagayam anc
Anislagan creeks; thence N. 17° 15' E., 2.75 Km., to the point
of beginning.
The municipality of Borja as herein organized shall begin
to exist upon the appointment and qualification of the
mayor, vice-mayor and a majority of the municipal coun
cilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of February,
in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
